items.title: Kawaii Animals HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:

items.title: City in the Sea
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Prepare to journey below sea level with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Far over the horizon line lies a mysterious city, built within the confines of massive walls protecting it from the ravages of the seas. Sunken deep below the tide lines, it's strangely abandoned now. What could have happened to its citizens?

items.title: Suspicious in Space
items.creator: Pixel Squared
items.description: Aliens have infiltrated your space ship, and it's up to you to discover them! Determine who the traitors are as a cute innocent teen, or dispatch of the humans in secret as a suspicious alien! Any of these rainbow colored astronauts could be the traitor, and it's up to you to find out who with this awesome new skin pack!

items.title: Skyblock One Block
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:

items.title: Winter Survival
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
You are the mechanic on a team of arctic explorers who have discovered the ruins of an ancient city lost in the frozen wastes. Your chopper went down in a blizzard so now you must survive impossible conditions for 31 days or figure out a way to signal for help... all while being preyed on by something ancient that you have awoken in the winter storm

-By Entity Builds

items.description:
Introducing Dragon World, an immersive experience in Minecraft with over 40 cute dragons! Explore the vast regions of Minecraft with custom block-based dragons spawning at your every turn. Experience new mobs, fun drops, two custom bosses for the chance to be the ultimate adventurer!

~42 dragons-themed mobs
~6 skins included, with one free dragon skin
~By Entity Builds
